map.基于House-Brackmann分级系统（I-VI级），评估面神经功能损伤程度: Based on the House-Brackmann grading system (I-VI), assesses facial nerve function impairment severity
map.House-Brackmann 面神经功能分级 I 至 VI：I 级正常、II: House-Brackmann facial nerve function grading I to VI: Grade I normal, II mild, III moderate, IV moderate-severe, V severe, VI complete paralysis; judged by symmetry of forehead wrinkle/eye closure/mouth corner etc.; degeneration >90% consider facial nerve decompression.
map.HB分级是面神经功能评估的国际通用标准，广泛用于贝尔面瘫、Hunt综合征、外伤性: HB grading is the internationally standard method for facial nerve function assessment, widely used for Bell's palsy, Hunt syndrome and traumatic facial palsy evaluation and efficacy follow-up. Facial palsy above grade III suggests poorer prognosis and needs active treatment. Combined with electroneurography (ENoG) to assess facial nerve degeneration; degeneration >90% warrants facial nerve decompression surgery.
map.额纹消失、闭眼不能、口角明显歪斜、联带运动明显：V 级（重度）。: Forehead wrinkle loss, unable to close eye, marked mouth-corner deviation, obvious synkinesis: Grade V (severe).
map.双侧对称、闭眼完全：I 级（正常）。: Bilateral symmetry, complete eye closure: Grade I (normal).
map.I 正常、II 轻度、III 中度、IV 中重度、V 重度、VI 完全麻痹。: I normal, II mild, III moderate, IV moderate-severe, V severe, VI complete paralysis.
map.静止对称性、运动（抬眉/闭眼/示齿/口哨）与联带运动。: Resting symmetry, movement (brow raise/eye closure/show teeth/whistle) and synkinesis.
